ITEM 1 | Off-white mashed or fluffy starchy mass with soft, flaky, crumbly-looking texture and matte surface, spread across upper-left center of plate, roughly 40% of plate area, about 2 cm tall at edges | 190
ITEM 2 | Reddish-brown smooth thick sauce with slightly glossy sheen and a few darker specks, mounded in center on top of the off-white mass, about 9 cm wide and 1.5 cm tall | 80
ITEM 3 | Orange-brown cubed pieces with browned, caramelized edges and slightly glossy surface, roughly 2 cm cubes, clustered lower-left of plate | 110
ITEM 4 | Dark brown-purple chunky pieces with firm, slightly wrinkled skin-like surface, about 2 cm, mixed among the orange cubes lower-left | 45
ITEM 5 | Bright red fruit cubes with moist, juicy look and smooth surface, about 2 cm pieces, arranged on right side of plate | 120
ITEM 6 | Pale orange-yellow fruit cubes with slightly firm, matte surface, about 2 cm, placed right side near red cubes | 60
ITEM 7 | Small dark red whole round fruits with smooth glossy skins, about 2 cm diameter, two grouped upper right of plate | 15
ITEM 8 | Orange-red roasted cubes with glossy, slightly caramelized surface and soft interior, larger chunks about 3 cm, lower center of plate | 90
